umbrella_agency.quote: The Idaho contractors board is hereby created and made a part of the division of occupational and professional licenses.

required.quote: An applicant for registration as a contractor shall submit an application under oath upon a form to be prescribed by the board

experience_source.quote: An applicant for registration as a contractor shall submit an application under oath upon a form to be prescribed by the board

available.quote: A contractor may provide a verified copy of any current and unrestricted license, registration, or other type of certification granted to the contractor by any incorporated municipality, county, alternative form of local government, or other municipal or political corporation or subdivision of this state issued pursuant to a duly adopted and enacted ordinance prior to January 1, 2007, to the board for review, along with a reciprocal registration fee not to exceed fifty dollars ($50.00)

requirements.value: Applicant must provide a verified copy of a current and unrestricted license, registration, or certification from a local government entity (pre-January 1, 2007 ordinance), pay a reciprocal registration fee not to exceed $50, and the prior credential must have been granted under provisions not less stringent than those of this chapter.
requirements.quote: If the review indicates that the license, registration or certification was granted under provisions that were not less stringent than those provided by this chapter, the applicant shall be issued a registration based upon reciprocal registration.

exists.quote: The Idaho contractors board is hereby created and made a part of the division of occupational and professional licenses. It shall be the responsibility and duty of the division administrator to administer this chapter

regulatory_model.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to engage in the business of, or hold himself out as, a contractor within this state without being registered as required in this chapter.

credential_type.quote: a certificate of registration and a wallet-sized card showing the registrant's name and showing a registration number shall be issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor violated any provision of this chapter, including failure to maintain required insurance coverage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor has violated any of the provisions of this chapter including, but not limited to, failure to keep current or provide insurance coverage as required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor violated consumer protection laws, including making fraudulent misrepresentations to consumers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor has violated any of the provisions of chapter 6, title 48, Idaho Code, relating to consumer protection including, but not limited to, making fraudulent misrepresentations to consumers

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor employed fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or unlawful means in applying for or securing registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor employed fraud or deception, made a misrepresentation or misstatement, or employed any unlawful means in applying for or securing registration as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor employed fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or unlawful means in applying for or securing a building permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor employed fraud or deception, made a misrepresentation or misstatement, or employed any unlawful means in applying for or securing a building permit or other permits for construction of any type

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor failed to pay the required registration fee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor failed to pay the required fee for registration as provided in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor was convicted of or engaged in conduct violating public laws relevant to contracting, making them a threat to public safety, health, or well-being.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor has been convicted of or has engaged in conduct constituting a violation of public laws, ordinances or rules of this state, or any subdivision thereof, relevant to contracting, reflecting on the registered contractor's ability or qualifications to continue contracting for other persons, and making the registered contractor a threat to the public safety, health or well-being

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor engaged in dishonest or dishonorable dealings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor has engaged in any other conduct whether of the same or a different character than hereinabove specified which constitutes dishonest or dishonorable dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor had a license, registration, or certification revoked, suspended, or refused in this or another jurisdiction, or omitted or failed to disclose such information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor had a license, registration or certification revoked, suspended or refused by this or another state, territory, incorporated municipality, county, alternative form of local government, or other municipal or political corporation or subdivision of this or another state, or omitted such information from any application to the board, or failed to divulge such information when requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor was adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor has been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor interfered with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding through misrepresentation or threats.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A contractor interfered with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by a willful misrepresentation of facts or by the use of threats or harassment against any person to prevent such person from providing evidence in a disciplinary proceeding, investigation or other legal action instituted in accordance with this chapter

insurance_required.quote: a certificate issued by an insurance company authorized to do business in the state of Idaho that the applicant has procured and has in effect a general liability policy, including products and completed operations insurance covering the applicant's construction operations in the sum of not less than three hundred thousand dollars ($300,000) single limit

definition_quote.value: "Construction" means the performance of building, altering, repairing, adding to, subtracting from, improving, reconstructing, moving, excavating, wrecking or demolishing any building, highway, road, bridge, or other structure, project, development or improvement to real property, or to do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith.
definition_quote.quote: "Construction" means the performance of building, altering, repairing, adding to, subtracting from, improving, reconstructing, moving, excavating, wrecking or demolishing any building, highway, road, bridge, or other structure, project, development or improvement to real property, or to do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith.

methods_authorized.quote: the performance of building, altering, repairing, adding to, subtracting from, improving, reconstructing, moving, excavating, wrecking or demolishing any building, highway, road, bridge, or other structure, project, development or improvement to real property

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A contractor registered pursuant to this chapter shall prominently display his contractor registration number for public view in his place of business, on advertising, contracts, permits, company or business letterheads, and purchase orders and subcontracts within sixty (60) days of issue of registration.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: A person performing work on one (1) undertaking or project considered casual, minor, or inconsequential, whether by one (1) or more contracts, the aggregate contract price of which, for labor and materials and all other items, is less than two thousand dollars ($2,000).

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: no incorporated municipality, county, alternative form of local government, or other municipal or political corporation or subdivision of this state shall implement its own program for the registration or licensure of construction contractors.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
